literal: With-love conjoined way-of-life they-say, to-precious-life, with-bone conjoined connection.
translation: They say that the connection of the precious soul with the bony body is for the purpose of leading a life conjoined with love.
modern: அரிய உயிரானது உடம்போடு பொருந்தி இருப்பதன் தொடர்பு, அன்போடு கூடிய வாழ்க்கையை நடத்துவதற்கே என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet explains the very purpose of human embodiment. The poet states that the union of the precious soul with the physical body of bones is meant for experiencing and practicing a life filled with love. The physical body is not just a material vessel, but an instrument designed specifically to express affection and kindness. Without love, the connection between the soul and the body loses its true meaning.
